description: This PHP source file defines the 'ViewHistory' class, which manages the display and handling of historical version snapshots within the SuiteCRM module builder interface. It includes methods for browsing, previewing, restoring, and unrestoring layout histories, leveraging other components like parsers, templates, and global modules.

classes.name: ViewHistory
classes.description: Class responsible for displaying and managing the history of layout changes in the Module Builder, including browsing, previewing, restoring, and undoing layout history actions.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Provides the title parameters for the module, translating the label and including the module title.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Determines the layout, initializes parser and history objects, and calls the appropriate history action based on request parameters.

methods.name: browse
methods.description: Displays a paginated list of layout snapshots using Smarty templates, allowing users to browse through different history states.

methods.name: preview
methods.description: Previews a specific layout snapshot by restoring it temporarily, rendering the appropriate view based on layout type, and then undoing the restore.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores a specific layout snapshot identified by timestamp.

methods.name: unrestore
methods.description: Undoes the last restore action, reverting to the previous layout state.
